findings.passage: We must ensure that every eligible voter, including our newly naturalized citizens, is not unfairly disenfranchised
findings.note: Quoted in her House caucus news release announcing a letter to the Secretary of State about cancelled registrations of people flagged as noncitizens who had since naturalized. Same release also quotes her: "It is crucial that we understand the processes used to verify voter eligibility and prevent errors."

findings.passage: Voter registration is vital to expanding civic engagement and ensuring that everyone has a voice in our government.
findings.note: From her statement on a federal raid of a voter-registration organization based on voter-fraud claims. Also states: "The Trump administration is trying to intimidate community advocates and volunteers, all of whom are engaging in the democratic process." Not about ID or citizenship documents directly; related election-integrity talk.
subjects: voter fraud claims and election-integrity enforcement
